results.title: FACT CHECK: ICC’s arrest warrant vs Dela Rosa still active, not dismissed by SC
results.content: The International Criminal Court's arrest warrant against Senator Ronald 'Bato' dela Rosa remains in effect. Nor has the Philippine Supreme Court dismissed proceedings against him.
